title_en: Du Tianfu, Sun Tinghua, Zhou Zhihua, Zhou Zhiyou, and He Minggao — case of speculation and profiteering
keywords_en: Criminal; Speculation and profiteering; First instance; Intermediate People's Court; Sichuan Province; Natural person; Criminal Law; Determination of principal and accessory in joint crime; Determination of particularly serious circumstances in the crime of speculation and profiteering; Supporting the plaintiff; Hunting and killing giant pandas; Trafficking giant panda skins; Joint crime
full_text_en:
Du Tianfu, Sun Tinghua, Zhou Zhihua, Zhou Zhiyou, and He Minggao — Crime of Speculation

Defendant: Du Tianfu, male, 22 years old, formerly a farmer from Guojia Village, Shuimo Township, Wenchuan County, Sichuan Province.

Defendant: Sun Tinghua, male, 44 years old, formerly a farmer from Dengjiatang Village, Sanjiang Township, Wenchuan County, Sichuan Province.

Defendant: Zhou Zhihua, male, 40 years old, formerly a farmer from Dengjiatang Village, Sanjiang Township, Wenchuan County, Sichuan Province.

Defendant: Zhou Zhiyou, male, 36 years old, formerly a farmer from Dengjiatang Village, Sanjiang Township, Wenchuan County, Sichuan Province.

Defendant: He Minggao, male, 26 years old, formerly a farmer from Dengjiatang Village, Sanjiang Township, Wenchuan County, Sichuan Province.

The above defendants Du Tianfu, Sun Tinghua, Zhou Zhiyou, and He Minggao were arrested on August 4, 1987; defendant Zhou Zhihua was arrested on May 1, 1987.

The People's Procuratorate of Aba Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province, filed a public prosecution with the Intermediate People's Court of Aba Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture on January 11, 1988, charging the defendants Du Tianfu, Sun Tinghua, Zhou Zhihua, Zhou Zhiyou, and He Minggao with the crime of speculation. The court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law and, after a public trial, found the following facts:

In June 1986, defendant Du Tianfu became acquainted with defendant Sun Tinghua. One day, Du Tianfu asked Sun Tinghua whether there was any giant panda skin available, saying that finding one could be sold for ten thousand yuan. Seeing an opportunity for profit, Sun Tinghua repeatedly said to defendants Zhou Zhihua, Zhou Zhiyou, He Minggao, and others: "You often go up the mountain; kill a giant panda and you can sell it for a big price. You go up the mountain and hunt, and I will find a buyer." Subsequently, Sun Tinghua provided He Minggao with 2 liang of gunpowder and 10 firecrackers. In July of the same year, Sun Tinghua, Zhou Zhiyou, and He Minggao went up the mountain together to hunt a giant panda but were unsuccessful. On November 22 of the same year, Zhou Zhihua and Chen Qingfu (who died of illness before the prosecution was initiated), carrying three gunpowder guns and leading two hunting dogs, went up the mountain to hunt wild boar. On the way, they met Zhou Zhiyou, He Minggao, and others carrying one gunpowder gun and leading two hunting dogs, also going up the mountain to hunt porcupine. Thereafter, the four split into two groups to search for prey. Zhou Zhihua, Chen Qingfu, and others went up along a gully and found that the hunting dogs had surrounded a giant panda up a tree. Zhou Zhihua said to Chen Qingfu: "Your gun is more powerful; you shoot first." Chen Qingfu then fired, and the giant panda, hit, fell to the ground. Immediately thereafter, Zhou Zhihua and Chen Qingfu fired simultaneously, killing the giant panda on the spot. At that time, Zhou Zhihua called over Zhou Zhiyou and He Minggao, who had been traveling on the other route. Zhou Zhihua and Zhou Zhiyou said: "Sun Tinghua said that giant panda skin can be sold. The skin must be removed whole, and one piece is worth several thousand yuan." Zhou Zhihua, Zhou Zhiyou, and He Minggao immediately skinned the giant panda. Zhou Zhihua suggested: "Zhou Zhiyou and He Minggao live in separate houses, so it is not easy for them to be discovered; hide the panda skin at their place." Thereafter, He Minggao told Sun Tinghua: "About the giant panda skin you mentioned last time, we have made contact for you." On January 17, 1987, Sun Tinghua went to Zhou Zhiyou's house to inspect the skin and cut off a small piece of fur to take away. Sun Tinghua informed Du Tianfu of the acquisition of the giant panda skin. On January 24, Du Tianfu went to Zhou Zhiyou's house, inspected the skin, offered a price of RMB 4,000, and asked them to go to Chengdu to collect the money. That evening, Du Tianfu took the giant panda skin to his home. On January 25, Sun Tinghua and Zhou Zhiyou accompanied Du Tianfu to Chengdu to collect the money. On January 27, in Chengdu, Du Tianfu intentionally shook off Sun Tinghua and Zhou Zhiyou, and while he was negotiating the sale of the giant panda skin on his own, he was seized by the public security authorities, and the giant panda skin was confiscated on the spot. During this period, Zhou Zhihua, unaware that the giant panda skin had been taken away by Du Tianfu, was still contacting Sun Tinghua regarding the sale of the panda skin.

The above facts are confirmed by witness testimony, the confiscated giant panda skin, the tools used in the crime, and the record of the crime scene inspection; the defendants also confessed without exception. The evidence is reliable and sufficient and is sufficient for identification.

The Intermediate People's Court of Aba Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture found at trial that the defendants Du Tianfu, Sun Tinghua, Zhou Zhihua, Zhou Zhiyou, and He Minggao jointly committed the criminal acts of hunting and killing a giant panda and illegally selling the panda skin, which constitutes joint intentional crime as provided in Article 22, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China. Du Tianfu, Sun Tinghua, and Zhou Zhihua played a major role in the joint criminal activity of hunting, killing, and illegally selling the giant panda skin. In accordance with Article 23, Paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Criminal Law, they are the principal offenders in this case and shall be given heavier punishment. Zhou Zhiyou and He Minggao played a secondary role in the joint crime. In accordance with Article 24, Paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Criminal Law, they are the accomplices in this case and shall be given a lighter punishment compared to the principal offenders. Considering He Minggao's criminal circumstances and his remorse and reform, and that he is no longer a danger to society, a suspended sentence may be declared in accordance with Article 67, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law. Du Tianfu masterminded the illegal sale of the giant panda skin; Sun Tinghua instigated others to hunt and kill the giant panda, provided gunpowder and firecrackers for that purpose, and participated in the hunting, killing, and illegal sale of the panda skin; Zhou Zhihua actively participated in the hunting and killing of the giant panda, the skinning, and the arrangement for the sale of the panda skin; Zhou Zhiyou and He Minggao participated in the hunting and killing of the giant panda and the sale of the panda skin. All of their acts constitute the crime of speculation as provided in Article 118 of the Criminal Law. The circumstances of the crimes of Du Tianfu, Sun Tinghua, and Zhou Zhihua are particularly serious, and in accordance with Article 1, Item (1) of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Severely Punishing Criminals Who Seriously Sabotage the Economy, they shall be severely punished. In view of the fact that Chen Qingfu has died, and in accordance with Article 11, Item (5) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, it is decided not to pursue his criminal liability.

Accordingly, the Intermediate People's Court of Aba Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, on January 31, 1988, rendered the following judgment:

Defendant Du Tianfu is guilty of the crime of speculation and is sentenced to life imprisonment. In accordance with Article 53, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, he is deprived of political rights for life.

Defendant Sun Tinghua is guilty of the crime of speculation and is sentenced to life imprisonment. In accordance with Article 53, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, he is deprived of political rights for life.

Defendant Zhou Zhihua is guilty of the crime of speculation and is sentenced to fifteen years' fixed-term imprisonment. In accordance with Article 52 of the Criminal Law, he is deprived of political rights for three years.

Defendant Zhou Zhiyou is guilty of the crime of speculation and is sentenced to seven years' fixed-term imprisonment.

Defendant He Minggao is guilty of the crime of speculation and is sentenced to three years' fixed-term imprisonment, with a three-year suspension of sentence.

After the judgment of first instance, none of the defendants appealed.
